svg.title: Exploded CAD view of the frame
svg.desc: Exploded CAD view of the 3D-printed wearable frame: front lens frame, two halves of the main housing, and two arms. Labels mark the camera and cable cover on the upper arm, the interference fit where the lower arm joins the housing that holds the electronic components, the butt hinge that lets the front frame fold, and the clearance fit at the lens-frame hinge.
